{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check if revenue has thousands separators
print(f"Unique revenue values (first 10): {df['revenue'].unique()[:10]}")

# Confirm that revenue is stored as string with commas
# Example: '1,234.56'
# We'll check if any revenue value contains commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"Number of revenue entries with commas: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"QA orders found: {qa_orders.shape[0]}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Refunded orders: {refunded.shape[0]}")

# Inspect the first few revenue values
print(f"First 5 revenue values: {df['revenue'].head().values}")"}
